theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (k + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → (∀ (η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (k + 1)) (φ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin k → Eucl m), (φ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x v = (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (k + 1)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → Z η = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (φ s)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Z
